question: Why must the essential Kaula teaching originating from the yoginīs be withheld?
premises: The Kaula essence is highly sacred
It must not be given indiscriminately
inference: The essential Kaula teaching, born of the yoginīs, must not be given to the unqualified.
uncertainties: sambhavam may qualify sāraṃ or stand in apposition depending on reading
plain_english: The essential Kaula teaching, which has its origin in the yoginīs, must not be given.
